title: Virocana-asurindo (or Attho)
text: 1. Sāvatthi nidānam || || 2. Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā divā vihāragato hoti paṭisallīno || || 3. Atha kho Sakko devānam indo Verocano ca asurindo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paccekadvārabāham nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu || || 4. Atha kho Verocano asurindo Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Vāyameth-eva puriso || yāva atthassa nippadā || nippannasobhaṇo attho || Verocanavaco idan ti || || [page 226] 226 SAKKA-SAṂYUTTA XI. [XI. 1. 8. 5. Vāyameth-eva puriso || yāva atthassa nippadā || nippannasobhaṇo attho || khantyā bhiyyo na vijjatī ti || || 6. Sabbe sattā atthajātā || tattha tattha yathārahaṃ || saṃyogaparamā tveva || sambhogā sabbapāṇinaṃ || nippannasobhino atthā || Verocanavaco idan ti || || 7. Sabbe sattā atthajātā || tattha tattha yathārahaṃ || saṃyogaparamā tveva || sambhogā sabbapāṇinaṃ || nippannasobhino atthā || khantyā bhiyyo na vijjatī ti ||
